items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'Claiborne' (Shiotoyama/Kaikotoyama) in the context of a book and a phone number, but does not describe a personal interaction or relationship with Kaikotoyama directly.

ctx.x: Eddergren. Yeah. And in the Japanese, I know you know his name. The Japanese? Call him Claiborne. Yeah. Call him Claiborne.
Yeah. You're Shiotoyama and Kaikotoyama. Yeah.

Well, he gave me his name as Claiborne. Yeah, I know, but that's the book. The whole number is written 924 All-Inst Street. Yeah. Whenever I wanted him, I called him. 924. Yeah. I called him. He's coming back. He's coming back. Yeah. But I'd have to get rid of that drum player. You know?
